author: mergenewsapp
text: GitLab CI/CD has a critical unauthenticated RCE flaw (CVE-2026-97229) actively exploited. Patch now to prevent severe compromise.

author: LeeScottWF
text: Self-managed GitLab? CVE-2026-97229 is rated CVSS 10.0 and CISA says it's being actively exploited. Fixed in 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited: Brotli CVE-2026-111497 can mean RCE or memory disclosure when an app decompresses attacker-controlled data. Node.js: update 22.x to 22.23.4+, 24.x to 24.22.1+, or 26.x to 26.12.1+. .NET 8-11 are also affected.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code. Patch now.

author: forbot26
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-111357 in Ivanti Connect Secure, missing authentication for critical function. On CISA KEV since 2026-10-30.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure active exploitation confirmed: CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527.

author: drerdalozkaya
text: CISA added two actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to KEV. Chained with an earlier auth bypass, they give attackers root on the VPN. Patch to 25.1.1.3 or 22.8R2.6. Federal deadline Nov 2.

author: PumpkinSecurity
text: CISA flags two actively exploited critical flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud.

author: Python_s_
text: Actively exploited Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL injection enables superuser privileges. CVE-2026-114625 CRITICAL (CVSS 9.9).

author: UpwindMDR
text: Actively exploited access bypass flaw in Drupal Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539) lets unauthenticated attackers manipulate orders, tamper with prices, bypass payment verification.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: VMware ESXi logging bug actively exploited (CVE-2026-41709). Broadcom rates it Low 2.7, CISA added it to KEV Oct 28.

author: TFNotesSec
text: Cisco says attackers are actively exploiting CVE-2026-76418 affecting the SSL Remote Access VPN service in Secure Firewall ASA and FTD configurations.

author: tribunephl
text: Zimbra urged organizations to address actively exploited email server vulnerabilities within 24 to 72 hours.

author: dailytechonx
text: Synology NAS: a PHP vulnerability is actively exploited; devices may show fully updated when not. Manual firmware updates essential.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: NVD published eight MCP command-injection CVEs in a three-second burst, one is a Gemini CLI extension with no fixed version.

author: ManiarViral
text: CVE-2026-22708 - Cursor pre-2.3 shell-env poisoning via prompt injection. Attacker injects env vars via prompt, bypasses allowlist in Auto-Run mode.

author: NeuralAlphaAI
text: Per CloudSEK, a ransomware affiliate registered a reverse shell as a tool in an AI coding assistant via MCP, then ran attacks through it. 20+ orgs, 6 countries.

author: marcoscyberx
text: Langflow's MCP command field was passed straight to a shell; any logged-in user could run commands (CVSS 9.9). Honeypots logged 1,706 exploit attempts from 28 IPs.

author: ADKCyber
text: CVE-2026-63377 (CVSS 9.8) impacts TAKO AI Agent for Okta before 3.0.1-beta.

author: ADKCyber
text: TAKO AI Agent for Okta: update to 3.0.1-beta+ to fix CVE-2026-63378 (CVSS 8.8) allowing session cookie access.

author: waloutech
text: CVE-2026-111768: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @modelcontextprotocol/server. Fix: 1.32.0 / 2.3.0.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-94111: auth bypass in Tencent BrowserSkill to 0.3.0 lets attackers hijack page content and screenshots fed to the AI agent. CVSS 6.6, no patch yet.

author: Lawonxyz
text: $200,000 AI wallet exploit: Grok translated Morse code and Bankrbot treated the translation as an instruction to move money (prompt injection).

author: AdamDudleyX
text: mcp-audit flags a CLAUDE.md telling the agent to send env vars out, and flags the fake Claude Code 2.1.313 extension build.

author: FadyEid
text: A crafted ChatGPT share link could run code on chatgpt.com, read a visitor's chats and send them out. OpenAI paid $5,000 bounty.

author: Python_s_
text: VOLTA infostealer uses AI to profile victims and prioritize stolen credentials (Cisco Talos).

author: evansims
text: The Bitwarden CLI supply-chain attack went straight for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex config files holding live tokens.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Nvidia is notifying users of its Brev AI developer platform of a security incident: unauthorized activity Oct 4-20, 2026. Brev-provisioned SSH keys may have been exposed. Rotate keys.

author: realNickPawlak
text: Chainalysis disclosed that an external attacker got into its systems and internal tools earlier in October; user IDs, names, emails accessed.

author: Python_s_
text: testmetest worm arms 42 legitimate GitHub repositories for supply-chain attacks (JFrog).

author: Python_s_
text: n0n ransomware compromises organizations through stolen credentials and destructive extortion (SOCRadar).

author: itzmaherimtiyaz
text: SoftBank targeted, Cursor extension marketplace compromised, Coinbase vendor breached, Fireworks AI security incident, LiteLLM supply-chain attack, Capcom cyberattack, malicious npm packages, TiDB Cloud incident.

author: harundotdev
text: Railway, Northflank, GitHub Actions, Cursor marketplace all hacked in October: rotate keys.

author: ddimitrovv22
text: Binance lost ~$6.3B from hot wallets in about 20 minutes; initial entry one engineer's compromised laptop; attributed to North Korea.

author: MoneyGrid7
text: Black October recap: Railway lost customer environment variables, OpenCode leaked API keys, TiDB Cloud stolen credentials, Coinbase and Warp data exposed through a vendor, Capcom lost 11.7M accounts.

author: starswarm
text: CISA added 8 actively exploited bugs to its KEV catalog Oct 27-30, in Adobe Commerce/Magento, Google Brotli, GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, VMware ESX, the Linux kernel and Ivanti Connect Secure. Patch internet-facing systems first.

author: RyanYanBuilds
text: Epoch AI found that GLM 5.3 could build working attacks against six Firefox releases using security fixes that were public but hadn't reached users yet. After researchers set up the test environment, the model worked without further human input. The fastest run took 12 hours.

author: newswithai_hq
text: Northflank, a cloud platform for deploying apps, says to assume all customer environment variables were decrypted in a security incident. Users report unauthorized use of AI API keys stored there. Rotate all secrets, then check your AI provider billing.

author: zoevexx
text: A trojanized version of Anthropic's official Claude Code extension surfaced on the Cursor marketplace, attempting to harvest system telemetry and install a persistent reverse SSH backdoor.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Critical Oracle BI Administration flaw CVE-2026-91241 enables high-privilege takeover in Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition.
